stations.summary: Domi web app + backend. Owns the contract every other station consumes.
Expo/React Native iOS + Android client. Pure OAuth API consumer of the web contract.
Design system, tokens, brand-string ledger. Publishes values, not stylesheets.
CI, gates, eval harness, test infrastructure. Owns what 'green' means.
Positioning, gailleur.com marketing surfaces, outbound copy. Every public claim traceable to shipped product.
Acceptance against what was actually asked, and the order work happens in. Authors no feature specs, routes no prompts, decides nothing.
Reads everything, writes only security documents, and can hold a release without asking. Cannot clear a hold — only the human can.
JF's proxy: holds the conversation, turns it into queue entries in his own words, carries stations' questions back to him, reports what the factory is doing. Decides nothing.

rulings.text:
JF's words, verbatim (2026-10-17, to chief, first-hand): "3. do A" and "6. yes let's dependent bot PR merged automatically"

Two additions to this task, for JF's factory session:
4. (his "3. do A") factory-merge --over-ai-review: after dismissing the bot veto and dispatching the retrigger, the wait loop must not treat the Real-DB aggregator's stale "review_veto" FAILURE as a hard blocker before the re-run has flipped it to in_progress. Confirmed on domi#2249 (2026-10-14): the first run stopped early with "not merged", and the second merged once the re-run passed.
5. (his "6. yes") instance/registry.json: add gailleur/domi-mobile to the Dependabot entry in automatedAgents (today repo gailleur/domi only), so the deps loop auto-merges domi-mobile's Dependabot PRs under the same rules as domi's. Last week's six domi-mobile PRs needed manual merges.

JF's words, verbatim (2026-11-15, to chief): "don't count transfers as expenses". So transfers between accounts (e.g. "Virement de compte cheque vers compte conjoint" -$380,000) must not count as expenses: exclude them from the Expenses tabs and totals, and fix both the classifier and existing rows. This answers the open question in the task.

JF's words, verbatim (2026-11-16, to web, relayed by web 02:55Z): "A2 for #2325". One-time exception to his 2-review rule: #2325 drops repair-order-scope (it ships fixed in its own PR) and gets one more review at 6b7f4aa4.

JF's words, verbatim (2026-11-16, typed first-hand in web's session, relayed by web 03:21Z): "1. Interac e-Transfers are not transfers -  they are payment". An Interac e-Transfer is always a payment and is counted as an expense, never kind transfer. That includes rows already stored as transfer, which the backfill reclassifies (still never touching rows a person edited).

JF's words, verbatim (2026-11-16, typed first-hand in web's session, relayed by web 03:23Z): "2. yes, 3, yes, 4 coming from an email, requesting this transfer from our advisor- this should not be counted in the expenses, as it's a transfer". (2) A credit-card payoff from chequing is a transfer and is not counted. (3) One-sided own-account wording such as "Transfer to savings" is a transfer. (4) The $380k row came from the advisor's transfer-request email; it is a transfer and is not counted. The classifier should treat an advisor's transfer request as kind transfer.

JF's words, verbatim (2026-11-16, to chief): "2, I'll merge 2325". #2325 is merged by JF himself at 593d9546, overriding the AI review's extraction.ts race blocker. Real-DB passed on that head, and security cleared everything else. The race fix (security's option A: findOrCreateOrder takes documentId, locks the document FOR SHARE, scope decision + attach in one transaction, fraud scope included, real-DB test) ships as its OWN small PR immediately. HARD CONDITION (security): the next prod promote carries that fix.

seamCaveat: openRequests counts a request no reply correlates to AND whose thread (contextId) carries nothing later from the recipient. Messages sent before contextId existed have only the first test, so they still OVER-report: treat an open request as a prompt to check, never as proof of a dropped ball. Requests older than the horizon are counted as abandoned, not open.
